newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Legend in business cooperation talks.
newsitem.headline: Legend in business cooperation talks.

text.p: Computer maker and distributor Legend Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it is in talks with its controlling shareholder about business cooperation.
The shareholder, The New Technology Developer Inc Institute of Computing Technology Academia Sinica, has a 41.76 percent stake in Legend.

The discussions were to "explore opportunities for business cooperation in various areas, including the possibility of acquiring and/or merging certain businesses", Legend said in a statement to the stock exchange.
"The discussions are still in a preliminary stage and no agreement has been entered into at this stage," it said.
Legend gave no other details of the talks.
Legend shares jumped HK$0.26 or 24 percent to HK$1.34 on Wednesday on heavy volume of 20.53 million shares worth HK$25.19 million.
